250ml red wine ≈ 250g (density near 1g/ml); knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.

3 sprigs fresh rosemary ≈ 6g total; modest weight for small herb sprigs.
2 dried bay leaves ≈ 1g total; modest weight for whole leaves.
